    car_patches = image_patch.find("white car")
    building_patches = image_patch.find("building")
    
    if not car_patches or not building_patches:
        return car_patches
    
    # Sort cars by their horizontal center
    car_patches.sort(key=lambda p: p.horizontal_center)
    
    # Find the rightmost building
    rightmost_building = max(building_patches, key=lambda p: p.right)
    
    # Filter cars that are to the right of the rightmost building
    right_cars = [car for car in car_patches if car.right > rightmost_building.right]
    
    return right_cars
